name: Mobile Screens: Grid
description: A template showing multiple mobile screens arranged and animated in a grid layout. Useful for showcasing several UI designs or app features at the same time.

name: Mobile Screens: Slider
description: A horizontal slider template that moves through mobile screens with smooth swipeable motion. Good for app feature tours and product demos built for mobile audiences.

name: Mobile Showreel
description: A full mobile showreel template that moves through app screens and UI moments in sequence. Great for app portfolio presentations and mobile product showcases where you want to show the whole product not just highlights.

name: New Message Notification [iOS]
description: An iOS message notification template with system-accurate animation. Great for messaging app demos and iOS UI presentations where authenticity matters.

name: Orbit: Cards
description: A template where cards animate in an orbiting motion around a central point. Good for showcasing multiple features or product highlights without cramming them all on screen at once.

name: Push Notification [Android]
description: An Android push notification template with a realistic slide-in animation. Good for Android app demos and cross-platform UI presentations.

name: Push Notification [iOS]
description: A single iOS push notification template that slides in from the top of the screen with realistic timing. Good for app demos and mobile UI presentations.

name: Rotating Mobile Screens: Black & White
description: A template showing mobile screens rotating in a black and white palette. Good for editorial-style app showcases and design portfolio reels where you want stronger visual contrast.

name: Rotating Smartphones
description: A template showing smartphones rotating in 3D space to reveal different screens and angles. Good for mobile product launches where you want to show more than one side of the product.

name: Sliding Smartphones
description: A template showing multiple smartphones sliding into frame from different directions. A solid format for mobile product launches where you want to show several screens at once.

name: Sliding Smartphones: Stories
description: An animated template showing smartphones sliding into frame with vertical story content already playing. Good for social media campaign previews and app story feature demos.

name: Sliding Web Screens
description: A template showing multiple web screens sliding into view in sequence. Great for website and SaaS product showcases where you want to show the product in context.

name: Text Message [iOS]
description: An iOS text message template where chat bubbles appear in a realistic conversation sequence. Good for messaging UI mockups and narrative social content.

name: The Route: Boarding Pass
description: An animated digital boarding pass template with a travel-themed UI. Great for travel app demos and aviation product showcases.

name: The Route: iOS Flight Tracker
description: An animated iOS flight tracker template with route visualization and real-time-style data. Good for travel and aviation app demos.

name: Web Gallery: Grid
description: A template presenting website designs in an animated grid. Great for web design portfolios and agency case studies.
